watches.name: Ellis Liberty Mint Edition
watches.description: New York, in a new shade. Meet the Ellis GMT in Liberty Mint. Inspired by the iconic blue-green patina of the Statue of Liberty and the spirit of Ellis Island, this distinctive Swiss-made GMT brings a fresh perspective to a New York minute. The Ellis GMT pays tribute to Ellis Island, a gateway for dreamers and doers seeking a better life. Its signature kinetic-texture dial features delicate waves radiating from the center, creating a mesmerizing play of light and shadow that evokes the rhythm of movement and the spirit of travel. In Liberty Mint, this distinctive texture takes on a fresh dimension, pairing a dynamic dial with a color deeply rooted in New York’s history.

Cheers.
